#!/bin/bash

# Docker Cleanup Script
# Uses environment variables for configuration

# Set default values
DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL=${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL:-"24h"}
DEFAULT_CLEANUP_THRESHOLD=${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_THRESHOLD:-"80%"}
CLEANUP_DANGLING_IMAGES=${CLEANUP_DANGLING_IMAGES:-"true"}
CLEANUP_STOPPED_CONTAINERS=${CLEANUP_STOPPED_CONTAINERS:-"true"}
CLEANUP_BUILD_CACHE=${CLEANUP_BUILD_CACHE:-"true"}

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "$(date): $1"
}

# Function to check disk usage
check_disk_usage() {
    df -h /var/lib/docker | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}' | sed 's/%//'
}

# Function to clean dangling images
clean_dangling_images() {
    if [ "$CLEANUP_DANGLING_IMAGES" = "true" ]; then
        log_message "Cleaning dangling images..."
        docker image prune -f
    fi
}

# Function to clean stopped containers
clean_stopped_containers() {
    if [ "$CLEANUP_STOPPED_CONTAINERS" = "true" ]; then
        log_message "Cleaning stopped containers..."
        docker container prune -f
    fi
}

# Function to clean build cache
clean_build_cache() {
    if [ "$CLEANUP_BUILD_CACHE" = "true" ]; then
        log_message "Cleaning build cache..."
        docker builder prune -f
    fi
}

# Function to clean based on threshold
clean_by_threshold() {
    local current_usage=$(check_disk_usage)
    log_message "Current disk usage: ${current_usage}%"
    
    if [ "$current_usage" -gt "${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_THRESHOLD%\%}" ]; then
        log_message "Disk usage above threshold (${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_THRESHOLD}), performing cleanup..."
        clean_dangling_images
        clean_stopped_containers
        clean_build_cache
        docker system prune -f --filter "until=${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL}"
    else
        log_message "Disk usage below threshold, no cleanup needed."
    fi
}

# Main execution
log_message "Docker cleanup started with configuration:"
log_message "  Cleanup Interval: $DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL"
log_message "  Cleanup Threshold: $DEFAULT_CLEANUP_THRESHOLD"
log_message "  Clean Dangling Images: $CLEANUP_DANGLING_IMAGES"
log_message "  Clean Stopped Containers: $CLEANUP_STOPPED_CONTAINERS"
log_message "  Clean Build Cache: $CLEANUP_BUILD_CACHE"

# Perform cleanup based on threshold
clean_by_threshold

log_message "Docker cleanup completed."

#!/bin/bash

# Simple Docker Cleanup Script

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "$(date): $1"
}

# Main execution
log_message "Docker cleanup started..."

# Clean dangling images
log_message "Cleaning dangling images..."
docker image prune -f

# Clean stopped containers
log_message "Cleaning stopped containers..."
docker container prune -f

# Clean build cache
log_message "Cleaning build cache..."
docker builder prune -f

# General system cleanup
log_message "Performing general system cleanup..."
docker system prune -f

log_message "Docker cleanup completed."
